name: KRBTGT account
short_description: KRBTGT is the Active Directory account whose key the Key Distribution Center uses to sign Kerberos tickets; rotating its password twice invalidates forged tickets.

evidence.quote: replication rights were used, schedule KRB TGT rotation twice, spaced by maximum ticket lifetime. We rebuild the app
We keep the KRBTGT periodic reset as ritual, a calendared acknowledgement that secrets decay.
